data.one_liner: Flutter package to implement a ticket-like widget in your application.
data.what_it_does: Provides a TicketWidget component that helps render ticket-styled UI elements with options for corner rounding, custom dimensions, and padding. It is written in 100% Dart with null safety support.
use_when: You need to display boarding passes, event tickets, or coupon designs in your UI
You want a pre-built widget styled specifically like a ticket
avoid_when: You need complex physics-based interactive ticket animations
You are looking for general-purpose layout containers without ticket styling
strengths: Easy to integrate with declarative configuration like width, height, and padding
Supports rounded corners out of the box
weaknesses: Limited documentation and features beyond basic ticket rendering
No documented advanced customization for ticket cutouts or notches
data.minimal_example:
TicketWidget(
    width: 350,
    height: 500,
    isCornerRounded: true,
    padding: EdgeInsets.all(20),
    child: TicketData(),
)
